pages.text: The $(item)forager's post$(): made with a mushroom, under the violet seal.

pages.name: Mushroom Hollow
pages.text: Common stone. Stock, post, basket in front.

pages.title: A Cave of My Own
pages.text: Not a field. A cave I build, five by five and five high, of cobble, stone, deepslate, tuff or moss. When the last stone is laid it grows over.$(br2)Mushrooms come up on the bed by themselves, one every $(thing)20 seconds$(). The one who picks them is not like the others. Bone meal fills the bed at once.
$(item)Spore loam$() takes every kind: mushrooms, both fungi, nether wart. Keep one of a kind in the stock, and use the post to choose what grows.
